conclusion: No preprocessing bug. E04 degradation attributed to domain differences between GAMMA and FairVision.
preprocessing_identical: E03 training transform = Resize(224,224) + ToTensor + ImageNet Normalize, no CenterCrop; E04 pipeline identical (input statistics matched exactly)
bscan_positions: GAMMA [0,36,73,109,146,182,219,255] of 256, uniform; E04 uniform 8 of 200: same relative positions
batchnorm: Encoder BatchNorm running statistics fixed at ImageNet values during E03; test-time BN re-estimation not evaluated

differences.fundus_branch_input: GAMMA color fundus (per-channel SD after normalization R 1.25, G 0.68, B 0.28) vs FairVision grayscale SLO (about 0.46 in all channels)
differences.oct_geometry: GAMMA B-scan 512 x 992 (width x depth) -> 224 scales width 0.44 and depth 0.23; FairVision 200 x 200 -> 1.12 in both
differences.oct_intensity: normalized mean about -0.74 (GAMMA) vs -1.37 (FairVision); SD 0.30 vs 0.39
differences.oct_region: GAMMA macula-centered per dataset documentation; FairVision not stated, inferred optic nerve head-centered

decision: skip BN re-estimation; proceed to in-domain E05 experiments
